acceptance: Binding with a .git URL either is refused at bind time with the canonical form named, or batch-finish accepts it.
A test covers URL, slug, case and .git variants.
context: 2026-11-06: separately, on batch native-bulk-load-remainder (#3952), `make batch-finish EXECUTE=1` exited 1 although its output showed "ok": true and both removals reported done. On arming-reliability (#4007), the hand cleanup loop with git worktree remove also exited non-zero silently. The exit status should match the result.
description:
On 2026-11-06, after PR #3981 (batch load-path-live-fixes) merged and all members were finished, `make batch-finish EXECUTE=1` refused with a repository mismatch. The leader had bound the final PR with bind_batch_pr using `https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git`, and the batch tooling compares against a slug. Once members are finished the batch is completed and bind_batch_pr cannot be re-run, so the leader cleaned up by hand: it checked each member tip against its accepted head and refs/pull/3981/head, then removed the worktrees and branches. Other batches (#3948, #3949, #3950, #3952, #3960) finished normally.

Change. Normalize repository identity (case, .git suffix, URL versus slug) in both bind_batch_pr validation and the batch-finish comparison, or refuse the non-canonical form at bind time when it can still be corrected.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; tracker runtime changes land in the todo-db repository, and only the pin and scripts land here.
